label: Trailer Cinematográfico (45s) · Sombra da Metrópole (Neo-Noir Thriller)
description: Trailer de suspense neo-noir em 16:9: chuva torrencial, reflexos de neon em asfalto escuro, silhuetas sob postes de luz amarelados, fumaça saindo de bueiros e tensão psicológica urbana.
resources: sound design de chuva, passos e tensão

scenes.prompt: Atmospheric neo-noir thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Heavy rain pouring over a gleaming dark Gotham-like city street at night. A lonely silhouette with a trench coat stands beneath a flickering tungsten streetlight. Steam rises from a cast-iron manhole cover. High contrast chiaroscuro lighting, 35mm film texture. Non-verbal sound design: heavy rain hitting wet pavement, muffled distant siren. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A CIDADE NUNCA DORME.

Atmospheric neo-noir thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Close-up on a vintage revolver cylinder spinning smoothly in gloved hands under the amber glow of a neon hotel sign outside a rain-streaked window. 85mm prime lens, moody shadows. Non-verbal sound design: crisp metallic ratchet spin and hammer cocking sound. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: ALGUNS SEGREDOS MATAM.

Atmospheric neo-noir thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Rapid kinetic sequence: vintage black sedan speeding through wet cobblestone alleys, tires skidding through puddles, flashing police cruiser lights reflecting on fractured glass. Non-verbal sound design: screeching tires, heavy engine roar and sudden high-tension riser. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A VERDADE TEM UM PREÇO.

Atmospheric neo-noir thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Low-angle shot inside an abandoned brutalist warehouse. Slanted shafts of moonlight cut through broken windowpanes as two armed silhouettes face each other in total standoff. Non-verbal sound design: eerie solo trumpet note echoing with immense reverb, heart-beat sub-bass. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: NINGUÉM É INOCENTE.

Atmospheric neo-noir thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Hero title reveal: bold crimson and chrome 3D typography emerges through thick rolling rain and shadows against the silhouette of towering skyscrapers. Slow camera zoom out. Non-verbal sound design: deafening cinematic gunshot impact fading into pouring rain. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: SOMBRA DA METRÓPOLE.

narration.text: Nesta cidade, a verdade não é o que você descobre. É aquilo que você escolhe esquecer para conseguir sobreviver.
narration.voice: voz masculina brasileira madura, áspera, rouca, grave, cínica e misteriosa, tom de detetive noir clássico

blocks.text: Nesta cidade, a chuva nunca lava a culpa.
Alguns segredos foram enterrados para nunca mais voltar.
Mas quando a verdade cobra o preço, todos pagam.
Nas sombras da metrópole, ninguém é inocente.
Sombra da Metrópole. Em breve nos cinemas.

audio.musicIntent: Dark neo-noir cinematic score with mournful brass, ticking suspense clocks, heavy sub-bass braams, discordant strings and sudden dramatic silences.
